localisation.f102r2_panel: Rightmost pharmaceutical panel on 8176x3864 canvas1006251, beyond central fold; approximate bounds x5250–8090/y230–3750. Exact panel inspection crop recorded above includes small border/sliver.
localisation.complete_row: Bottom/third row, two root figures and left container. Exact whole-row crop x5200 y2400 w2850 h1200 preserves both root outlines and label neighborhoods.
localisation.incidental_exposure: Adjacent f101v and f102r1 panels, other f102r2 rows, visible prose/glyphs and canvas borders were localization-only and not interpreted/transcribed.

herbal_anatomical_extent.detail: One continuous drawing from horizontal hooked root through bulb/crown and tall branching green stem, numerous rounded lobed leaves, to a large terminal outlined flower/head.

fragment_anatomical_extent.detail: Root system and enlarged crown retained, with only short bare stubs above it. No tall green stem, developed leaves or flower. Calling this strictly root-only would suppress the retained crown/stubs.

extent_difference.criterion: Herbal drawing has developed leafy and flowering shoots; nominated pharmacy drawing has no developed leaves/flowers and is root/crown dominant. This does not prove physical removal.

distinctive_concordance: An elongated horizontal brown root has a regular succession of stout upward hooks and downward lobes.
The far-right root terminus curls back left underneath the main axis as a long sweeping return tail.
At the left of that axis is an enlarged upright bulb/crown with pale internal channels/open spaces and short radial roots.
The conjunction of these three features matches the nominated pharmacy root much more closely than its sole same-row tubular neighbor.
counter_features: The number, spacing and outlines of hooks/lobes are not an exact one-to-one tracing.
The pharmacy crown is more openly looped/perforated and ends in short leafless stubs; the herbal crown continues directly into a tall leafy stalk.
The pharmacy root has an additional conspicuous central downward-left projection with a face-like oval end; the equivalent protrusion is not securely matched in the whole drawing.
Paint density and local dark/green washes differ. Shared brown coloring alone is not distinctive identity evidence.
The leaf and flower diagnostic features of the herbal drawing are absent from the fragment, so those features cannot independently confirm coidentity.

continuity_or_cut.observed: Several crown stubs terminate abruptly; a central downward projection has a rounded face-like terminal. No unequivocal illustrated severing interface replaces the herbal stem/root attachment.
continuity_or_cut.reason: These end shapes do not distinguish actual cutting from schematic abbreviation, natural ends or stylized contours. Root-to-crown continuity remains.

simplification_rival.description: The same plant or design represented through an abbreviated basal/root detail, without a performed removal event; generic reuse of an elaborate drawing motif also remains possible.

label_owner.basis: Two isolated inscription islands sit over separate root figures; target island is above its nominated root/crown in otherwise blank row space. No equal-near competing same-row plant under that island.
label_owner.uncertainty: Ownership is inferred from spacing/placement; no tether and no textual ownership semantics are available.

whole_row_inventory.extent: Brown horizontally extended branching root/crown; short leafless crown stubs; no leafy or flowering shoot.
whole_row_inventory.label_geometry: One isolated inscription to the right of upper crown, above the left third of its horizontal root. Approximate native label envelope x5890–6220, y2650–2730; no transcription.
whole_row_inventory.neighbor_role: GB2 target; sole plant neighbor for GB3.

whole_row_inventory.extent: Pale horizontal tubular/collared root axis with numerous thin descending roots, oval end faces, and one thin upright leafless branching shoot.
whole_row_inventory.label_geometry: One isolated inscription above the left portion of its tubular axis and left of its upright shoot. Approximate native label envelope x6910–7230, y2720–2820; no transcription.
whole_row_inventory.neighbor_role: GB3 target; sole plant neighbor for GB2.

whole_row_inventory.extent: Separate vertical green/red cylindrical container at left; not a plant fragment.
whole_row_inventory.label_geometry: No isolated row3 plant-label island positioned more closely to this container than to its nominated root figure. Writing visible elsewhere is not read.

neighbor_alternatives.comparison: Row3plant2 has an oval-ended tubular axis, collars, many fine descending roots and a thin bare upright twig. It lacks plant1’s serial stout hooks, looped crown and long return tail; it is not an equally adequate f18v anatomy rival. The separate left container lacks the root motif.
neighbor_alternatives.neighbor_label_alternative: The other row3 inscription island is positioned over the other plant. Neither requires swapping labels to attain the nominated anatomy comparison.

qualified_pair.basis: Distinctive shared root design; securely different visible anatomical extent; singular geometrical owner; no equally adequate same-row neighbor. Qualification concerns the preregistered drawing relation only.

explicit_unclear: External biological/same-species identity beyond motif coidentity.
Text meaning and whether labels name whole plant, part, property or procedure.
The function/anatomical status of the central downward face-like protrusion.
limits: Image comparisons are development/exposed hypotheses, not independent holdout identification.
No species identification, glyph/prose reading, word interpretation, ROOT/q gloss, process assertion or new semantic hypothesis.
A singular geometrical label owner does not prove whether its text names a plant, part, property or operation.
Cutting/removal is UNCLEAR; anatomical omission may be drawing simplification.
GB2 and GB3 share pharmaceutical physical leaf f102r and the same f102r2 panel/row; they are not two independent pharmaceutical contexts.
